name: Unofficial NEET Patches
author: pawbeans
description: Fixes for bugs in the game itself: saves that fail (a dead house spider, a fuse left over from loading, any single broken object), put-out fires that come back after loading, story events that break when a character is gone or repeat after an error, status effects that freeze, stick or depend on the frame rate, frame rate and vsync settings that don't stick, promoted cards losing their stats, the thief's beanie that can't be picked up, autosave and timed spawners (sinks, loose change, sprays) that stop after loading a save, worn clothes that fall out of the world after loading, deaths that get stuck with a mask on, skeletons that ruin every pair of black pants, clothes lost for good when you die, paint loaded from a save that doesn't show, custom shirts that look plain when worn, pans that stay hot for good after food burned in them, and a second hat, mask or pair of glasses left off after loading. Every fix can be switched off on its own.
